key_derivation: Switch list = every AC_ARG_ENABLE / AC_ARG_WITH / AM_MAINTAINER_MODE in configure.ac (grep returns exactly the nine above plus configure.ac:18); consumer list = every `if <NAME>` block in Makefile.am, each of which must correspond to an AM_CONDITIONAL — the two lists match one-for-one, which is why the set is complete (an AM_CONDITIONAL with no `if` is dead, and an `if` with no AM_CONDITIONAL fails automake).
